notes.title: New Features and Fixes
notes.content:
This update addresses some requests from the community, a new task from Statement (on Discord) and some general bug fixes.

Changelog
[list]
[*] Add a new task: Mini calculator (by @Statement)
[*] Add label parsing as any data type - before only jmp and *ui commands compiled with labels
[*] Add comment support in line with command - everything after first # is not compiled
[*] Fix manual for jump and comparison commands
[*] Fix Longest cycle test cases not following the description
[/list]

If you have any feedback, please share or join the [url=https://discord.gg/HRfDArjkrd]discord [/url]for ProxOS.

notes.title: Update: New Commands
notes.content:
This update introduces several new commands, manual improvements and a new task. 

Changelog
[list]
[*] Add a new task: Longest cycle
[*] Add new jump commands: jleq*, jgeq*
[*] Add new comparison commands: leq*, geq*
[*] Add absolute value commands: abs*, iabs*
[*] Add value sign command: sgn*
[*] Add (single param) neg*
[*] Add stack peek*
[*] Update manual with new commands
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes #3
notes.content:
This update greatly improves and adds new sections to the manual. 

All task descriptions were updated to follow a more similar format and some extra information was added to specific tasks for edge cases.

Changelog
[list]
[*] Improve the existing manual
[*] Improve Task descriptions
[*] Add exit codes to manual
[*] Add stack push and pop commands
[/list]

If you have any feedback, please share or join the [url=https://discord.gg/HRfDArjkrd]discord [/url]for ProxOS.

notes.title: Update Notes #2
notes.content:
This update is mostly focused on fixes, no new tasks or major changes.

Changelog
[list]
[*] Add ^ as allowed character in Code Editor
[*] Add more conditions needed to be eligible for leaderboard (line count and more?)
[*] Add run in background to Settings
[*] Change the default volume
[*] Create custom error logs for some engine exceptions
[*] Change byte and short commands to not override entire register
[*] Disable warnings for missing glyphs in font atlas
[*] Fix File Explorer not refreshing in some cases
[*] Fix parameters using constant as short or byte setting upper 24 bits to 1
[*] Fix mod*, div* by 0 crashing to desktop
[*] Fix manual unsigned short range
[*] Fix Page Down breaking Code Editor
[*] Fix Code Editor/Viewer scrollbar outside of text (load long code, scroll down then load short code)
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes #1
notes.content:
This is the first update of ProxOS.

Changelog
[list]
[*] Add a new task: [b]Simple maze[/b]
[*] Add < > ( ) { } as allowed character in Code Editor
[*] Add [b]windowed mode[/b]
[*] Change Memory and Display to have minimum size of 4B
[*] Change Cloud sync to include all files inside User folder (up to 100 files)
[*] Change leaderboard to show [b]40 entries[/b]
[*] Fix Global leaderboard showing less than it should
[*] Fix Fibonacci puzzle test case inputs
[*] Fix manual code snippets containing jump commands
[*] Fix accessing memory or display at uint_max - 4 causing game to crash to desktop
[/list]
